limitations: Tracking coverage is not gesture correctness. For chart-authored clips it describes only the retained source video.
Chart poses and movement arrows require RSL teacher review; a drawing does not specify a complete motion.
Long occlusions are interpolated and can create wrong finger shapes.
Front-surface clearance checks do not certify arm-arm contacts or linguistic correctness.
Text sequences retain Russian source order; no grammatical translation.
source: 22 chart-authored letters; 102 video-timed clips including 1 VOG whole-phrase references; other clips retain per-entry provenance
